## License & Use Posture

The PDF and all extracted derivatives are reproduced here under **United States Copyright Act §107 fair use**:

- **Purpose:** *internal scientific research review only* — comparing pipeline reproduction outputs against published Cell-paper panels to assess reproduction quality.
- **Nature:** factual scientific figures.
- **Amount used:** entire paper retained for provenance verification (SHA-pinned); rendered figures excerpted into internal comparison artifacts.
- **Market effect:** none — internal review artifacts are NOT distributed externally.
